Mark your calendars mi gente, because the Main Floor is about to turn into puro Bachata 💃🔥 Sholeh and Bachata Connection are pulling up to teach you the steps live, no excuses, no two left feet allowed. Class first, then the floor opens up and it's social dance time — partner optional, vibes mandatory. Come solo, con pareja, o straight up Bachata All-Star status, da igual, hay espacio para todos. This is the kind of night that turns strangers into dance partners and dance partners into familia. Vamos a aprender, vamos a bailar, vamos a sudar un poquito bajo esas luces neon ✨ Don't sleep on this one — spots on the floor fill up fast once the music hits.

Neon glow, slow bachata beats, sudor en la frente 🌙✨ Picture this: the lights dim down, Sholeh's got the floor, and that bassline starts creeping into your hips before you even realize you're moving. Class breaks it down step by step first, then the Main Floor flips into a full social — bodies swaying, hands finding hands, risas everywhere. It's intimate, it's sensual, it's a little sweaty in the best way. The kind of night where the music gets under your skin y no quieres parar. Bring your energy, leave your inhibitions at the door — puro sabor, puro movimiento.

No experience? No partner? No problem 🙌 This floor is for everybody — the first-timers, the ones who've been practicing in their kitchen, the regulars who already know every step. Sholeh and Bachata Connection are here to teach with zero judgment, solo good energy and good música. Come as you are, come alone, come with your whole crew — todos caben aquí. This is community built one step at a time, literally. You'll leave with new moves, maybe a new dance partner, and definitely that warm Azúcar familia feeling. Puro Bachata, puro corazón 💛
